title: Autumn Junk Journal Paper Pack Printable, 20 Fall Vintage Botanical Papers, Dark Academia Scrapbook Paper, Digital Collage Sheets
description:
Need beautiful fall backgrounds for your junk journal, without hunting for matching papers? This pack gives you 20 coordinated autumn vintage papers, ready to print.

WHO IT'S FOR
Junk journalers, scrapbookers and card makers who love vintage botanicals, dark academia and warm fall tones.

WHAT YOU GET: 22 printable pages in US Letter and A4
1. 20 full-page papers: maple parchment, ledger leaves, fern hollow, owl moon, mushroom plate, moth specimens, old letters, crows, harvest still life, rust damask, sage botanical, autumn plaid, library books, sheet music, old map, apothecary, pinecones and berries, dark leaves, tea-stained and walnut solids
2. 2 START HERE pages with printing tips

You receive 2 PDF files: one in US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and one in A4. Every paper is full bleed, high resolution and ready to print.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- A complete, coordinated palette of rust, ochre, sage and sepia
- Busy focal papers and quiet solids, so you can layer them easily
- Use them as journal pages, covers, signatures, mats, tags or collage pieces

HOW IT WORKS
1. Purchase and download the files from the Purchases section of your Etsy account (use a web browser; the Etsy app does not download digital files)
2. Open the PDF that matches your paper: US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) or A4
3. Print at 100% / Actual size on matte paper or light cardstock
4. Cut, fold, layer and create

GOOD TO KNOW
- This is a digital download: nothing is shipped
- Colors may vary slightly between screens and printers
- Personal use and physical handmade items you sell (journals, cards, scrapbooks) are welcome; reselling or sharing the digital files is not
- Some of the artwork was created with the help of AI tools, then selected and finished by hand
- Because this is a digital product, returns are not accepted. If anything is wrong with your files, message me and I'll make it right!

Part of the Ember & Oak autumn collection by Oakfold. Every piece is designed to match.
